g.title: MlQube: Training, testing and serving
g.text: 4 · Model lifecycle for one tenant (retail-1042, project namespace retail-1042-churn)

g.title: cluster_legend_frame
g.text: Develop: explore data in a notebook, write the pipeline in Python with the Hera SDK
Build: push to GitHub; GitHub Actions runs tests and pushes training / serving images to ECR
Submit: the Hera code submits a workflow (golden template train-evaluate-register) to Argo Workflows
Schedule: Kueue admits it to the tenant's GPU queue; Karpenter starts a tenant-dedicated spot GPU node
Train and track: read data from the tenant bucket; log runs and register the model version in MLflow
Test: evaluate against the baseline, then deploy the candidate to a staging endpoint for integration tests
Promote: the model owner promotes the version in MLflow; MlQube opens a GitOps PR (ModelDeployment)
Deploy: after approval and merge, Argo CD rolls out a KServe canary in prod (vLLM for LLMs)
Serve: business applications call the endpoint through the internal ALB
Retrain: CronWorkflows retrain on a schedule and register a new version, which goes back to step ⑥
